name: Wide DDA Cell Traversal
definition: An algorithm to traverse a 4x4x4 grid of 'wide cells' within an AABB using a DDA (Digital Differential Analyzer) approach, generating bounding boxes and t-intervals for each cell to optimize octree traversal.
summary: Wide DDA Cell Traversal traverses a fixed 4x4x4 block of child cells in strict ray order, differing from standard DDA by operating on coarse-grained nodes rather than individual voxels.
